facts.fact: The Minister of Communications' preface of May 2000 presents the National Policy on Telecommunications as the policy approved by the President and launched in October 1999, revised by a steering committee under the National Council on Privatization.
The full policy text, with seventeen chapters, was published in May 2000 under the Ministry of Communications.
The policy assigns policy formulation to the Ministry of Communications and regulation to the Nigerian Communications Commission, and sets up a National Frequency Management Council in the Ministry.

Chapter 2 sets short-term objectives over 3 years and medium-term objectives over 5 years, and Chapter 16 says the policy will be reviewed from time to time; the document gives no end year, so 2005 is five years from its date.
